title: VKMS - FO Support
jobDescription: Job Description TX-SD Security Technologies Support: Function Owner Support in Vehicle Key Management System (VKMS) Responsibilities Key Tasks Our team is responsible for the secure and reliable management of cryptographic keys across the VW Group. The Function Owner Support role ensures that all aspects of the Vehicle Key Management System (VKMS) are coordinated, documented, and aligned with internal standards and stakeholder requirements. Manage and document change requests (CRs) using tools like Jira, DOORS, Codebeamer. Maintain and align QLAH content across brands and stakeholder domains. Participate in Change Control Boards (CCBs) and prepare delta documentation and confirmation sheets in line with VW Group standards. Translate functional requirements into structured specifications and test cases. Maintain test specifications across all levels (function, integration, blackbox). Coordinate with brands and ECU suppliers to ensure consistency and reuse. Track and triage defects, CRs, and feature deliveries with software suppliers. Align supplier deliveries with internal specifications and release documentation. Specify and review interfaces for production and customer service commissioning. Coordinate with backend system owners (e.g. FAZIT, System42) for integration. Define and maintain diagnostic specifications (Di DAS, DTCs, DDTs). Operate and improve key usage processes across brands and systems. Provide stakeholder support for function-related issues and deviations. Create and refine technical and procedural concepts (e.g. VKMS2 → VKMS3). Develop and maintain test concepts and specifications for all VKMS versions. Provide expert-level support for escalated incidents. Assist in long-term roadmap planning and strategic coordination. Contribute to the further development and evolution of VKMS within the VW Group, including new function variants, architectural transitions, and future security requirements. Job Requirement Technical Skills : Proven experience in automotive security technologies, demonstrated through concrete project references. Deep understanding of cryptographic key lifecycle management (generation, distribution, storage, rotation, revocation). Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434 and OEM-specific key management requirements. Experience with embedded ECUs and secure software workflows. Deep experience in software development (C & C++) for security technologies and ownership of secure software workflows. Ability to analyze and validate key management protocols and their implementation in vehicle networks. Proficiency in tools such as Jira, DOORS, Code beamer, KPM. Knowledge of diagnostic systems and standards (e.g. UDS, Di DAS, ODIS, ODX, Autosar). Experience with backend systems and toolchain integration (e.g. FAZIT, System42). Competencies & Skills Profound knowledge of embedded security technologies, secure communication, and automotive standards. Experience with test management and requirements management platforms (e.g., Code Beamer, DOORS, JIRA, KPM). Strong analytical skills for interpreting test data and deriving technical maturity grades. Effective communication and coordination with suppliers, test houses, and internal teams. Organizational skills for cross-brand process alignment and documentation management. Ability to handle confidential and security-relevant information appropriately. Familiarity with VW Group process standards and templates. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Soft Skills Clear and structured communication with internal and external stakeholders. High reliability and ownership in managing complex technical topics. Strong documentation and decision-making capabilities. Ability to adapt to changing requirements and environments. Commitment to continuity and knowledge retention throughout the contract duration. Apply Now

jobDescription: Role Overview Own and drive the end-to-end test strategy, planning, and execution for Time Master and Wake-Up Monitor software, ensuring release readiness through measurable quality, robust automation, and traceable verification. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain the test strategy, test plans, and release quality gates (unit/integration/system/regression). Lead test execution across teams, leading by example; plan resources, schedules, environments, and test cycles. Own defect triage and quality reporting (KPIs, trends, root cause themes, readiness summaries) to stakeholders. Drive test automation and continuous integration. Ensure compliance with automotive quality standards and processes (e.g., ASPICE, ISO 29119 where applicable). title: Security Lead -Incident Management
jobDescription:
About the Company Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in
2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles. About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital) The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website ( https://cariad.technology ). Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment. About our Group CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components. Job Description: We are looking for a SOAR/SIEM Engineer with 3–9 years of experience in cybersecurity operations to strengthen our threat detection and response capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, cloud security, and automation of incident response workflows.
